expected.quote: (a) In case of emergency hospitalisation, within 24 hours of admission.
(b) In case of planned hospitalisation, at least 72 hours prior to admission.

conditions: counted from the date of discharge
expected.quote: The claim with the necessary documents shall be submitted within 30 days of the date of discharge from the hospital.

conditions: counted from completion of post-hospitalisation treatment
expected.quote: Documents for post-hospitalisation expenses shall be submitted within 15 days of completion of post-hospitalisation treatment.

expected.valueText: Delay in intimation or submission may be condoned where the Insured Person shows the delay was due to reasons beyond his or her control
expected.quote: Delay in intimation or submission may be condoned by the Company where the Insured Person shows that the delay was due to reasons beyond his or her control.

valueList: Duly completed and signed claim form
Original final hospital bill with itemised break-up and payment receipt
Investigation reports supported by the prescription of the attending Medical Practitioner
Cancelled cheque or bank account details for NEFT payment
expected.quote: iii. Original final hospital bill with itemised break-up and payment receipt
In case of accident, the First Information Report (FIR) and the Medico-Legal Certificate (MLC), where conducted, shall also be submitted.

expected.valueText: KYC documents of the employee are submitted with the first claim, where not already provided to the Policyholder
expected.quote: The KYC documents of the employee shall be submitted with the first claim, where not already provided to the Policyholder.

expected.valueText: The Company or the TPA obtains the medical records directly from the hospital and does not reject the claim for want of such records
expected.quote: The Company or the TPA shall obtain the medical records directly from the hospital and shall not reject the claim for want of such records.

expected.valueText: Claim status can be tracked on the TPA portal using the claim reference number communicated in the acknowledgement
expected.quote: The status of a claim may be tracked on the TPA portal using the claim reference number communicated in the acknowledgement.

conditions: counted from receipt of the last necessary document
expected.quote: The Company shall settle or reject a claim within 30 days of receipt of the last necessary document.

conditions: where the claim warrants an investigation
expected.quote: Where the circumstances of a claim warrant an investigation, the Company shall complete the investigation and settle or reject the claim within 45 days of receipt of the last necessary document.

expected.valueText: Interest at a rate 2% above the bank rate from the date of receipt of the last necessary document to the date of payment
expected.quote: In case of delay in payment beyond the above period, the Company shall pay interest at a rate 2% above the bank rate, from the date of receipt of the last necessary document to the date of payment.

expected.valueText: Rejection is decided by the Claims Review Committee and communicated in writing stating the specific reason and the policy clause relied upon
expected.quote: Rejection of a claim shall be decided by the Claims Review Committee of the Company and shall be communicated to the Insured Person in writing, stating the specific reason and the policy clause relied upon.
Rejection of a claim shall be decided by the Claims Review Committee of the Company

expected.valueText: Where a claim is settled for less than the amount claimed, the settlement letter lists each deduction with the policy clause relied upon
expected.quote: Where a claim is settled for less than the amount claimed, the settlement letter shall list each deduction with the policy clause relied upon.

expected.valueText: Grievance Redressal Officer, Demo General Insurance Company Limited, toll free 1800-333-4444
expected.quote: The Insured Person may contact the Grievance Redressal Officer, Demo General Insurance Company Limited, toll free 1800-333-4444.

conditions: counted from receipt of the grievance
expected.quote: The Company shall acknowledge the grievance and resolve it within 14 days of receipt.

valueList: Grievance Redressal Officer of the insurer
Bima Bharosa portal (Integrated Grievance Management System) of the IRDAI
expected.quote: If the grievance is not resolved, the Insured Person may register it on the Bima Bharosa portal (Integrated Grievance Management System) of the IRDAI, and may thereafter approach the Insurance Ombudsman.
The Insured Person may approach the Insurance Ombudsman under the Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017
for a claim not exceeding Rs. 50,00,000.

conditions: counted from the final reply or rejection by the Company
expected.quote: The complaint shall be made to the Insurance Ombudsman within 1 year (365 days) of the final reply or rejection by the Company.
Nothing in this policy limits the right of the Insured Person to approach the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
